Kemi Adeyemi  
📞 +91 98765 43210 | ✉️ kemi.adeyemi@email.com | 📍 Bengaluru, India  

Professional Experience  
At Shopify Nigeria, I contributed to UI enhancements for flagship products, refining user flows while validating API endpoints for seamless integration. My freelance work at RemoteCo involved architecting microservices for an inventory management system, where I leveraged Node.js and MongoDB to optimize data retrieval and reduce latency. Currently, I’m building e-commerce platform features at EcoCart Solutions, focusing on scalability with React, Python, and PostgreSQL to support high-traffic scenarios.  

Technical Skills  
Proficient in JavaScript, where I implemented dynamic UI components for Shopify’s product pages and optimized client-side rendering for faster load times. MongoDB and Node.js were central to developing the RemoteCo inventory system, enabling real-time tracking and reducing query response times by 25%. Python’s versatility allowed me to automate backend tasks at EcoCart, streamlining data processing workflows. REST API design is a core competency, with experience crafting endpoints for both Shopify’s internal tools and EcoCart’s public-facing API. React powers the majority of EcoCart’s frontend, where I prioritized accessibility and performance, ensuring compatibility across devices. Web performance optimization remains a focus, with recent efforts targeting critical rendering paths to improve page speed metrics by 15%.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Pan African University, completed in 2023. The curriculum emphasized problem-solving through practical projects, including a capstone on distributed systems that honed my understanding of scalable architecture.  

Projects  
Developed a modular inventory management system for RemoteCo, utilizing Node.js and MongoDB to create a fault-tolerant microservices architecture. The project reduced manual reconciliation time by 30% and scaled to handle 50,000+ daily transactions. At EcoCart, I designed a user authentication system integrating OAuth2 and JWT, enhancing security while simplifying login processes for 10,000+ monthly users. A recent initiative involved refactoring legacy code to adopt a service-oriented architecture, improving maintainability and reducing deployment risks.  

Languages  
English (native), with intermediate proficiency in Hindi for local collaboration.  

Certifications  
AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (2023) – Demonstrated foundational knowledge of cloud computing principles and services.
